consequence.statement: A configured ip-allocation-timeout flag is no longer honoured, since the flag is removed and CIDR identity allocation always happens asynchronously.
consequence.remediation: Remove the ip-allocation-timeout flag from the configuration.

original.statement: The `ip-allocation-timeout` flag has been removed; CIDR identity allocation is now always asynchronous, making the timeout obsolete.

decision.reason: [ev-0b06499d6851] lists `ip-allocation-timeout` under "Removed Options" and says the flag has been removed. Any configured value therefore stops being honoured, which is what setting-ignored means (a removed key). The same evidence says CIDR identity allocation now always happens asynchronously, so the timeout is obsolete. Removing the flag, as the proposed remediation says, is the right step. The evidence does not say whether a leftover flag is silently ignored or makes the agent fail to start, so confidence is low.
